name: Sodakki
source:
Dakki is playful, teasing Yousen and asking her to be his ‘doll’. Of course, the strong minded Yousen would never fall under Dakki’s spells and resisted him in every advance… This only fuels Dakki’s desires greater as he tries over and over again to take Yousen for his own… Is this only for his twisted desires, or is there more to this story…?

[From [url=http://azurebluephoenix.tumblr.com/post/72077349897/lgs-houshin-engi-the-dating-sim]Sapphire Dreams Tumblr[/url]]
